headline: Uber Profit Forecast Disappoints on Driver Shortages and Middle East Conflict
summary: Uber reported a disappointing profit forecast. The company cited driver shortages and the Middle East conflict as headwinds impacting its financial outlook.
why: Weaker-than-expected profit forecasts from major gig-economy platforms reflect broader labor market tightness and geopolitical risks affecting operational costs.

impacts.name: Uber Technologies
impacts.why: Driver shortages and regional conflicts negatively affected Uber's profit forecast.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A disappointing profit outlook directly lowers future earnings expectations, triggering sell-offs among investors.
